notes: Structural context weights set to equal (1.0) for all TT_CPD scenarios pending experimental differentiation. Rationale: insufficient in vitro or in silico data to distinguish formation rates between structural contexts (adjacent-domain, extension, loopout). All T-T pairs treated as equally likely to form CPDs regardless of junction geometry. Update weights and increment schema_version minor digit when experimental data become available. See cpd/VALIDATION_GUIDE_PHASE0.md for the update protocol.

global.notes: watch_bases controls which bases are tagged in the SVG during rendering. Extend to ["T", "C"] when TC-6-4PP detection is enabled.

photoproducts.notes: Primary UV photoproduct in DNA origami. All structural context weights set to 1.0 (equal) pending experimental differentiation — two thymines adjacent on the same strand or unpaired and adjacent on opposite strands are treated as equally likely CPD candidates regardless of structural context.

sequence_contexts.notes: TT step is the canonical CPD substrate. Rate normalized to 1.0 as the reference.

adjacent_domain_ds.notes: Equal weight — T-T adjacent on the same strand within a double-stranded domain. Weight will be differentiated from other contexts once experimental data are available.

extension_extension.notes: Equal weight — T-T on paired extensions (unpaired, adjacent on opposite strands at a crossover junction).

loopout_loopout.notes: T-T on paired loopouts from different strands (unpaired, adjacent on opposite strands at a crossover junction).

within_loopout.notes: T-T adjacent within a single thymine loopout (same strand, single-stranded loop). Placeholder — set to equal weight pending experimental data distinguishing within-loopout from cross-strand loopout geometry.

extension_loopout.notes: Equal weight — T-T on a mixed extension-loopout pair (unpaired, adjacent on opposite strands at a crossover junction).

geometry.notes: Approximate C5-C5 distance threshold for CPD formation. Standard B-form stacking places adjacent bases ~3.4 Angstrom apart. Threshold allows for thermal fluctuation.

references: Schreier et al. (2007) Science 315:625 — direct observation of CPD formation dynamics
Douki & Cadet (2001) Biochemistry 40:2495 — sequence-context CPD quantum yields
Ravanat et al. (2001) J Photochem Photobiol B 63:88 — structural determinants of CPD formation

photoproducts.notes: Disabled pending experimental validation of structural weights in DNA origami contexts. TT-6-4PP is a significant photoproduct (~25% relative to TT-CPD in B-form DNA) but its formation geometry in non-canonical structural contexts (extensions, loopouts) is uncharacterized. Enable and update weights once in silico or in vitro data are available.

sequence_contexts.notes: Approximate relative rate vs TT-CPD in B-form DNA. Placeholder only; update with experimental data.

adjacent_domain_ds.notes: Placeholder. Scaled from B-form relative rate; structural context adjustment unknown.

geometry.notes: 6-4PP has distinct geometry from CPD; this threshold may need to differ. Update when structural data available.

references: Douki & Cadet (2001) Biochemistry 40:2495 — TT 6-4PP quantum yield relative to CPD
Kim & Sancar (1991) Biochemistry 30:8623 — 6-4PP structure and formation mechanism

photoproducts.notes: Disabled. Requires extension of base detection to include C (watch_bases must add 'C'). TC-6-4PP is a documented photoproduct but less frequent than TT variants. All weights are placeholders.

sequence_contexts.notes: Placeholder relative rate vs TT-CPD. Update with experimental data.

geometry.notes: Placeholder. TC-6-4PP geometry may differ from TT variants.

references: Douki & Cadet (2001) Biochemistry 40:2495 — TC 6-4PP vs TT-CPD relative yields
Perdiz et al. (2000) J Biol Chem 275:26732 — wavelength dependence of TC vs TT photoproducts
